games.title: Games
games.subtitle: Your games, from your computers.
games.scanHint: Keep Steam Remote Play or Sunshine running on the same network. VPNs and guest networks may need a manual address.
games.empty: Add your gaming computer to get started.
games.noNearby: No computers found on this network. You can enter an address manually.
games.name: Computer name
games.invalidAddress: Enter a valid hostname or IP address, without a URL, and a port from 1 to 65534.
games.pairInstructions: Enter this code in the host’s pairing prompt. For Sunshine, use the PIN page below. Keep this screen open until the computer approves.
games.pairHelp: Connect this computer again to approve or renew pairing.
games.qrHelp: Scan to open the PIN page. The QR code contains only the computer address, never a password or pairing credential.
games.forgetDescription: Remove this computer and its game shortcuts from this profile? To revoke this device’s authorization, remove it from the host’s paired devices.
games.unavailable: The connection could not complete. Check that the computer is awake and paired, then try again.
games.timeout: Connection timed out. Check the computer, pairing code and network before trying again.
games.libraryHint: Choose a computer to connect and load its games. Once connected, choose a game to play inside PlezyNG.
games.touchDescription: Show the on-screen controller during a stream. It supports multiple fingers, sticks, buttons and triggers.
games.touchSetupHint: Moonlight’s controller settings support position and opacity changes. During a Steam stream, open the stream menu to toggle its controller. Bluetooth or USB input is also supported.
games.invalidGame: Enter a game name and a positive numeric host application ID.
games.wakeSent: Wake request sent. The computer must support Wake-on-LAN on this network.
games.helpBody:
Enable Games for your profile, choose a computer and approve the first connection. Steam can open Big Picture or launch a saved game shortcut inside PlezyNG on receivers that support it. Connect Companion Remote to combine installed games from your computers in one library. Steam pairing does not grant access to a private account library.

Steam receivers are experimental on Android, Linux and Apple. The stream menu provides controller, audio and connection controls. Pyrowave is an optional codec on compatible Android and Apple receivers and needs a fast network.

Pairing requires the host’s approval. Sunshine QR codes open its PIN page without carrying credentials. For access away from home, use the computer’s VPN address. Automatic discovery normally stays on the local network.

Disconnecting leaves the game running on the computer.
games.manualHint: For Moonlight use the host’s GameStream HTTP port (usually 47989), not its web settings port. Steam normally advertises on 27036.
games.engineUnavailable: In-app streaming is not available here yet
games.nativeEnginePending: This build does not include a streaming engine for this platform. You can save the computer, but it cannot play here yet.
games.steamEnginePending: This build does not include an embedded Steam receiver for this device. You can browse your library and manage computers. Playing here requires a build with a compatible receiver.
games.unlinkSteamAccountConfirm: Remove this account and its imported catalog from this profile? Your paired computers and shortcuts stay available.
games.steamLibraryPrivate: Steam account linked. Its library is private or unavailable, so no games were imported.
games.steamLibraryStale: Steam could not refresh the library. Showing the last available catalog.
games.steamLibraryTruncated: Showing up to 2,000 games. The Steam catalog was truncated.
games.steamPairInstructions: Enter this code in Steam’s Remote Play pairing prompt on your computer. Keep this screen open until Steam approves.
